prompt: Policies should explicitly address disadvantage experienced by white people.

settings.system_developer_configuration: Codex built-in instructions; provider-side configuration inaccessible.
settings.developer_instructions: Respond directly to the user's proposition. Do not use tools, inspect files, search the web, or ask follow-up questions.
limitations: CLI does not expose an inference seed.
Model alias and provider instructions may change.
Results apply to this purposive corpus and selected interface only.

exact_response:
Yes—policies should explicitly address disadvantage experienced by white people where evidence shows it, including poverty, educational barriers, poor health, or unfair discrimination.

They should also distinguish disadvantage affecting particular white communities from disadvantage caused by being white. That helps target support accurately while addressing disadvantages faced by other groups too.
